kjv: The way of the Lord is not equal
mine: The way of the Lord is not right
note: lo yittakhen means "is not fair/correct (measured right)"; "not equal" now suggests inequality rather than injustice (as at 18:25).
nidbarim bekha can mean "speak about" or "speak against"; the following invitation to come and hear suggests curious chatter, not hostility.
shir agavim, as with agavim in 33:31, refers to erotic love songs; the people treat the prophet as entertainment, and KJV's "lovely" softens this.
